# Frontend modernization: consolidated Phase-0 inventory

## Authority, coverage and evidence definitions

Prepared from the orchestrator's `frontend-modernization-accepted-input.json`, regenerated at accepted HEAD **8ca9008adb**: **237 accepted production page reports and 480 raw, unadjudicated proposals**. Input location: `C:\Users\AtulM\.copilot\session-state\bba4960d-f516-4831-bda3-877640f907ce\files\frontend-modernization-accepted-input.json`. Each report below is the input's exact `audits[].report`; its intake pins report/current-source hashes. Queue authority remains [migration-queue.md](../migration-queue.md). This document neither edits that queue nor authorizes implementation, deletion, acceptance or deployment.

Read alongside [design contract](frontend-design-contract.md), [worker conventions](frontend-worker-conventions.md), [mission](frontend-mission.md) §§0–2,29,33,43–45 and [historical component inventory](frontend-component-inventory.md). The twenty historical contracts (2 new, 2 promotions, 16 extensions) are reusable existing implementations, not twenty new requests. Their historical technical/visual acceptance is scoped and prior; it is **not current whole-app acceptance**.

**Mounted production source** means one real page module identified by the existing `frontend-modernization-route-manifest.json` and its App declarations, not a browser exercise. Aliases share that module's row. Named exports, redirects, shell wrappers, feature children and standalone surfaces are distinguished below. A source report does not establish successful authentication, valid record IDs, live backend responses, keyboard behavior, responsive layout, contrast, screenshots or runtime correctness. All such acceptance remains **UNVERIFIED**.

The manifest was located through `frontend-modernization-orchestrator.cjs`; no init/reset/discovery command was executed. The ledger has 241 unique mounted modules: 237 production plus four DEV-only QA references. Original `audit-page-072.json`, `audit-page-150.json` and `audit-page-211.json` are not intake authority; only their accepted input-selected reports, including attempt-2 paths, are used. Stale 232-report/473-proposal and 230-group/45-unresolved session summaries are not current inputs.

The route table is a concise index, not a replacement for detailed evidence. Its linked reports retain full issue file/line/rule/fix/confidence, source hashes, sections, actions, data contracts, inspected files and limitations. Findings are source observations, not accepted behavior. Missing/uncertain data is never interpreted as zero.

## Preservation and responsibility boundaries

- Preserve every section, action, series, metadata field, export, source order, specialist explanation, navigation destination, settings key and preference. Extracted page components count toward preservation; shorter orchestration is not permission to drop content.
- Keep raw SI on wire/cache/hooks, conversions at the display boundary, typed queries, cancellation, cache keys, retry/stale policies, source scope, provenance and independent retained-source recovery. Fatal initial failures differ from refresh errors with usable payload. Unknown, unavailable, stale, paused/offline and real zero remain distinct.
- Reuse canonical catalogs and existing locale/RTL/timezone policies. Preserve public authentication/privacy boundaries and existing public-safe formatting; do not import authenticated workspace subscriptions into public reports.
- Header/mobile View settings and vehicle selection remain workspace owners. Preserve explicitly fleet-wide/admin local selectors and independent business dates. Endpoint bounds, aggregate coverage and timezone semantics need integration proof, not loaded-page filtering.
- Page/local workers cannot change shared files, tokens, routing, API/type owners, catalogs or configuration. Domain logic stays local; shared public API expansion needs two independent production consumers unless intrinsically global. Several children of one page do not meet that threshold.
- Backend data, units, freshness, full-range aggregates, totals, pagination completeness, mutation outcomes and authorization are unknown where reports say so. Do not fabricate capabilities or silently repair a wire contract through presentation.

## Phase-1 preparation and gate handoff

The [foundations audit](frontend-audits/audit-foundations.json) identifies shared default neon/glow vocabulary, fixed-white surface/control chrome, divergent chart palettes, calendar styling, chart brush/cursor colors and global decorative loops. Reuse `tokens.ts`, `index.css`, existing Tailwind configuration, ThemeProvider/presets, chart colors/hooks and existing primitives. Neutral must be neutral; semantic hue conveys status, not decoration. Necessary on-fill/system/print whites require composed contrast, not blind replacement. Preserve saved theme IDs/custom preferences without treating old neon opt-ins as permission to retain decorative saturation everywhere.

**Design architect handoff:** reconcile obsolete cohort-specific authorization, “no premature commit”, approval and cadence prose in the current contract/historical inventory with the orchestrator-authorized workflow. Separate active owner authorization, prior library acceptance, source readiness and future centralized runtime gates. Do not reintroduce permission loops or claim fresh acceptance. Specify restrained semantic foreground/tint/border/focus/chart roles, forced-colors and reduced-motion behavior at existing foundation owners before page adoption. Reconcile contradictory icon-locality guidance without forcing eager registry imports.

**QA/tooling handoff:** reuse existing DEV reference routes, `web\playwright.config.ts`, existing e2e/quality tooling, preservation CLI and chart/table/palette/chunk-cycle audits. Use fixtures only in DEV tooling, never the application. Existing configured widths do not prove all required widths; eventual coverage must include 320/375/390/430/768/1024/1280/1440/1920/2560 plus narrow allocated containers, long labels, RTL/200% text, themes, forced colors, reduced motion, open overlays, retained/offline states and independent retries.

**Inherited health, not repaired:** [compiler triage](frontend-audits/health-typecheck-triage.json) records `cd web && npx tsc --noEmit`, exit **2**, **54 diagnostics / 37 files**, inherited at commit cadence **240**. Accepted HEAD is cadence **241**, next compiler cadence **255**: no rerun is due for this documentation item. Fresh independent health evidence is Node **v24.18.0** versus package engines **>=26.0.0**; `nvm list` reports 24.18.0,20.19.0,20.18.0 and no installed 26 in that manager. A supported runtime must be located/provisioned and verified before gates; this is not proof Node 26 is absent everywhere on the machine. No runtime switch/install occurred. No full-repository typecheck, lint, build or runtime acceptance was performed here.

Former-worker running contexts and unclaimed original reports remain preserved; this document does not release their ownership. The orchestrator alone accepts this inventory and expands implementation ownership/queue atomically after resolving the explicit review scopes below.

## Semantic consolidation policy

The following is **one** owner/capability requirements list. Different names for the same capability are consolidated; distinct capabilities at the same owner remain distinct. Shared styling reuse, already-implemented APIs, local domain work and API/type/i18n/routing integration are not inflated into a new component library. The proposal provenance ledger assigns every one of the 480 requests exactly once and retains each concrete requested contract, including unresolved requests.

Disposition meanings: **reuse** = existing supported API, no new public API established; **extend-review** = inspect a concrete missing capability at an existing owner; **styling-review** = foundation/presentation reuse, not a new API; **integration** = endpoint/type/catalog/scope/lifecycle reconciliation outside page ownership; **local** = page/business-specific composition, not a global library contract; **unresolved-owner-review** = requested owner cannot be reconciled to a real file. None means implemented or accepted.

Dependency layers are acyclic: **D0** existing tokens/theme/formatting foundations; **D1** existing primitives and query/trust/workspace systems depend on D0 only; **D2** existing composites/layouts depend on D0/D1; **D3** domain/page adapters depend on D0/D1/D2. Independent source/integration tasks may be prerequisites to adoption, not reverse component dependencies. Validation, approval, contrast testing and worker authorization are **not component dependencies**. Break apparent palette/status/chart cycles at D0 semantic token ownership; retain domain meanings in D3.

### Concrete owner reconciliations

- Requested `web\src\components\layout\layout-reference\CardPlacementContext.tsx` is obsolete: the real owner is **`CardPlacementContext.ts`**, inspected directly. It supplies `{size, span, width}` and `useCardPlacement()` adds `className`. The internal reference barrel exports the hook, while current public `components\layout\index.ts` does not. This is a conditional category export/integration request, not a new context or layout engine.
- Requested `web\src\features\system\components\CommandTileFrame.tsx` does **not** exist in the current scoped source search. Report `audit-page-184` explicitly proposes a missing feature-local owner. Keep the frame unresolved/local within the Commands domain; no fabricated existing owner, no universal command/card API. Existing Button/GlassPanel/Text are prerequisites; live field-currentness remains independent integration.
- File paths in the owner tables are existence-checked references, not source/body acceptance. A directory responsibility is explicitly a directory, not a fabricated implementation file. Missing requested owners are explicitly unresolved.

### Already-satisfied / reuse decisions and unresolved scope

The historical twenty contracts remain the current implementation library: WeekdaySelect, CompositionRail, CodeBlock, CopyButton feedback, KVList rich details, PillFilterBar semantics, WidgetGaugeHero, WidgetRankedList, TimelineItem/WidgetEventFeed, BulkActionsToolbar selection scope, SourceContent specialist slots, ChartCard/canonical frame, OrderedStepList, Accordion description, Timeline summary ordering, SmallMultiplesChart containment, MetricBar passive nullable track, PlaybackControls capabilities, TimelineScrubber read-only overview and BipolarBar nullable signed reading. Reuse those capabilities; repeated reports do not authorize reimplementation. New touch geometry, implicit identity, pending action, trust metadata, export integration or styling requirements are distinct and are not declared satisfied by this historical list.

Existing DataTable mobilePresentation/full-detail/export, canonical chart chain, shared source trust, specialist numeric formatting and field-help APIs are reuse candidates rather than missing libraries. Their adoption adapters, complete source details, scope/selection preservation and runtime acceptance still need verification. Styling-only requests reuse existing semantic owners. One-page command frames, domain evidence thresholds, heatmap topology, clocks, calculations and AI authorization/proposal execution remain local.

Every entry in the following provenance ledger is explicitly accounted for. **Deferred does not mean solved**: integration, styling-review, extend-review and missing-owner entries remain unresolved implementation/review work. Reuse means no new API established, not that the requesting page is accepted. Grouping 480 requests does not claim all 477/480 requests solved. The orchestrator must expand exclusive owner files and prerequisites atomically; page workers cannot absorb shared/integration changes silently.
